# Variable `SDK_AS_ARCH`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies architecture-specific assembler flags when building nativesdk recipes. By default, the value of SDK_AS_ARCH equals the one of BUILD_AS_ARCH.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SDK_AS_ARCH)
